newsitem.title: USA: IPL, ANDATCO sign definitive merger pact.
newsitem.headline: IPL, ANDATCO sign definitive merger pact.

text.p: IPL Systems Inc and ANDATCO said Monday they have signed a definitive merger agreement following their February 10 announcement of their letter of intent.
Under the proposed terms, shareholders of ANDATCO would receive about three shares of IPL stock for each share of ANDATACO common.

The agreement also anticipates that Harris Ravine, an outside director of IPL, will become chief executive of the combined companies after closing. The merger is conditioned upon his entering a long-term employment contract.

The merger will be accounted for as a purchased business combination. Subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, the transaction is expected to be submitted for shareholder approval in the second quarter.
Both companies are computer storage providers.IPL had revenues of $17.1 million in 1996. ANDATCO revenues for the same period were about $100 million.
